messages:
ana_marketing: Quick kickoff: Tiny Hack Pack launch -> one-page refapp, 20m tutorial video, short benchmark post, and 1hr webinar. Target publish Wed 14:00 PT. Need owners for demo, bench, landing, ops, and social. Focus: low-friction dev onboarding + clear perf/cost messaging.

jay_devrel: Ill own the tutorial + live demo. Idea: chat-summarizer refapp that highlights embeddings + streaming. Keep code <200 LOC so folks can fork quickly.

sam_engineer: Ill run microbenches. Two workloads: short-chat (<=512 tokens) and long-context (>=4096). Will produce p50/p95 latency and cost-per-1k tokens. Need a 300-prompt sample set from Jay.

maria_growth: Ill own landing + signups. Routing: Webinar signups -> HubSpot list "Tiny Hackpack - Webinar" -> SFDC lead mapping. Use utm_campaign=tiny_hackpack. Social: email + X + Dev Forum Thu AM.

kevin_prod: README should include recommended runtime config and a try-it-now curl. Suggest batch_size=16, kv_cache=true, quant=4bit. Also will prepare webinar Ops runbook (monitoring + fallbacks).

content-bot: Note: calendar slot reserved Wed 14:00. Drafts due Mon EOD. Preview site: https://tiny-hackpack-preview.redwood.dev (internal).

jay_devrel: Uploaded demo script to drive: https://drive.redwood/demo-script (placeholder). Run command: `./run.sh --model open-x --port 8080`. Live plan: 10m demo, 10m Q&A. Ops buddy requested to watch GPUs.

sam_engineer: First bench results posted to sheet: short p50=45ms p95=180ms, long p50=210ms p95=650ms. Cost calc in sheet. I'll export a CSV of prompts+responses for the blog.

maria_growth: Figma landing copy ready; CTAs: [Try in Browser] + [Register Webinar]. I'll wire form to HubSpot webhook -> Zapier fallback -> SFDC. Hidden field example: `source=tiny_hackpack_webinar`.

kevin_prod: Pushed README snippet: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"open-x","prompt":"Summarize...","max_tokens":128}'` + short troubleshooting note (reduce batch_size or enable kv cache on OOM).

ana_marketing: (typo) ana_marketing: :thumbsup: Final owners: 1) refapp + tutorial  Jay; 2) benchmark blog + narrative  Sam + me; 3) landing + registration + social  Maria; 4) webinar ops runbook  Kevin; 5) promo assets  Maria + Jay. Publish Wed 14:00 PT, social blast Thu 09:00 PT.

ana_marketing: Please drop final asset links, preview URLs, and recording notes into this thread before Tue EOD. If blockers, flag now so we can reassign.
